transcript: Speaker A (Tomato): My Aryan got 100 out of 100 in Maths. His father and I are so proud. Speaker B (Okra): That's great! My daughter is planning to take up Arts. What about your son? Speaker C (Cauliflower): Mmm... my son... he is study Science. [laughter] Speaker D (Cabbage): क्या हुआ गोभी? तुम रो क्यों रही हो? [What happened Gobi? Why are you crying?] Speaker C (Cauliflower): आज किटी पार्टी में सब मुझपे हँसे, क्योंकि मुझे इंग्लिश बोलनी नहीं आती। [Today at the kitty party everyone laughed at me because I don't know how to speak English.] Speaker D (Cabbage): बस इतनी सी बात! ये लो, तुम PW Talk ऐप यूज़ करना शुरू करो। देखो, इसमें एक AI इंग्लिश टीचर है, रीवा। तुम इससे रोज़ 10 मिनट बात करो, ये तुम्हें इंग्लिश बोलना सिखा देगी। गलती भी हो तो शर्माओ मत, रीवा जज नहीं करेगी। ये तुम्हें डेली लाइफ में इंग्लिश में कैसे बात करना है, ये सिखा देगी। इसमें ढेर सारे प्रैक्टिस क्वेश्चंस और वीडियोस हैं तुम्हारे लिए, जिससे तुम इंग्लिश बोलना सीख सकती हो। डेली प्रैक्टिस करो, लेवल अप करो और देखो कैसे महीने भर में तुम कॉन्फिडेंटली इंग्लिश बोलने लगती हो। फिर देखते हैं किसकी हिम्मत है जो तुम्हारा मज़ाक उड़ाए। [Just this little thing! Here, start using the PW Talk app. Look, it has an AI English teacher, Riva. Talk to her for 10 minutes daily, she will teach you how to speak English. Even if you make a mistake, don't feel shy, Riva won't judge you. She will teach you how to speak English in daily life. It has lots of practice questions and videos for you, through which you can learn to speak English. Practice daily, level up, and see how within a month you start speaking English confidently. Then let's see who dares to make fun of you.]
on_screen_text: My Aryan got 100 out of 100 in Maths. His father and I are so proud. That's great. My daughter is planning to take up Arts. What about your son? My son he is study Science. Kya hua Gobi, tum royi kyun ho. Aaj kitty party me sab mujhpe hase kyunki mujhe English bolni nahi aati. Bas itni si baat. Tum PW Talk app use karna shuru karo. Dekho isme ek AI English teacher hai Riva. Tum isse roz 10 minute baat karo. Yeh tumhe English bolna sikha degi. Galti bhi ho to sharmao mat, Riva judge nahi karegi. Yeh tumhe daily life me English me kaise baat karna hai yeh sikha degi. Isme dher saare practice questions aur videos hai tumhare liye jisse tum English bolna seekh sakti ho. Daily practice karo, level up karo aur dekho kaise mahine bhar me tum confidently English bolne lagti ho. Phir dekhte hai kiski himmat hai jo tumhara mazak udaye.
summary: An animated cauliflower character is mocked at a social gathering for poor English. Her cabbage friend consoles her and recommends the PW Talk app, highlighting its non-judgmental AI teacher, Riva, for daily practice.
